[SWS_EthTSyn_00265]
Status:
DRAFT
Upstream requirements: RS_TS_20047
⌈When EthTSynPortRole is set to DYNAMIC or TIME_MASTER, ports (for eth con-
troller only 1 port and for switch individual port) shall transmit Sync and Follow_Up
message according to the configuration parameter EthTSynGlobalTimeTxPe-
riod.⌋
Note: For [SWS_EthTSyn_00265] Immediate Synchronization is not further affected
by the port-specific EthTSynGlobalTimeTxPeriod.
Refer to chapter Message Processing in [1, PRS Time Synchronization Over Ethernet
Protocol] for additional requirements.
